title: Vientiane International Half Marathon 2027 Review: A Charity Race in Laos's Capital
meta_description: Vientiane International Half Marathon 2027 review: March 7 in Nakham -- organised by Events for Good Laos, near a golden Buddhist stupa icon.
dek: Set for 7 March 2027 in Nakham, Vientiane, this half marathon is organised by Events for Good Laos -- a charity-oriented events group -- in a capital city on the banks of the Mekong, home to the golden Pha That Luang stupa.
verdict: The Vientiane International Half Marathon joins the Luang Prabang Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch as a second Laos race with a genuine charitable throughline -- organised by Events for Good Laos, an events group whose name itself signals a philanthropic mission, rather than a commercial promoter. Vientiane is Laos's capital, on the banks of the Mekong near the Thai border, home to Pha That Luang, a golden Buddhist stupa that serves as a national icon. Single-distance (21K) format keeps the race focused. Registration status wasn't yet announced at the time of this research.

sections.heading: A Second Laos Charity Race
paragraphs: The Vientiane International Half Marathon offers a single distance -- 21K -- in Nakham, Vientiane, organised by Events for Good Laos. [1] This joins the Luang Prabang Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch as a second Laos race with a genuinely charitable organisational model, distinct from the commercial and brand sponsors dominating most races in this research.

sections.heading: Vientiane: Capital on the Mekong
paragraphs: Vientiane is the national capital of Laos, located on the banks of the Mekong River close to the Thai border, with a population of 840,000 as of the 2023 census. [2] It served as the administrative capital during French colonial rule, was occupied by Japanese forces during World War II, and reoccupied by French paratroopers in 1946. Today it's home to Pha That Luang, a golden Buddhist stupa considered a national icon, alongside other significant temples like Haw Phra Kaew, which formerly housed the Emerald Buddha before it moved to Thailand.

sections.heading: Single-Distance Focus
paragraphs: Unlike most races in this research batch, which offer multiple categories, this event sticks to a single 21K half marathon -- similar to the Luang Prabang Half Marathon's own single-distance format. [1] That focus keeps the field aimed at committed half-marathon runners specifically.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status has not been announced. [1] The race is listed with AIMS World Running alongside its official Events for Good Laos site, giving it reasonable international visibility despite Laos's smaller race footprint generally.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a charity-organised half marathon in Laos's historic capital -- near a genuinely significant golden Buddhist landmark -- appeals, the Vientiane International Half Marathon on 7 March 2027 is a strong, meaningful pick. Watch official Events for Good Laos channels for registration to open.
